text_block_list.text:
Rewriting legend, Mejiro Ryan surged past 
the great superstar Oguri Cap to seize 
victory!

In the winner's interview, she shouted 
that it was thanks to her fans that she 
was able to seize this glory.

Defeated by Mejiro Ryan, Oguri Cap found 
herself so captivated by her running that 
she murmured she wanted to race her again 
and again.

Having achieved true growth, Mejiro Ryan 
became an Umamusume capable of captivating 
even superstars.
